titles.title: National Forest Timber Sales Cost Recovery Act of 1991
National Forest Timber Sales Cost Recovery Act of 1991

A bill to provide for the full recovery of the Federal Government's costs of selling timber on national forest lands, to require site-specific identification of national forest lands that are not economically suitable for timber harvesting, to remove that land from the suitable timber base and make associated adjustments in the allowable sale quantity, to assist in the economic transition of timber dependent communities, and for other purposes.
